key_insight: The paper examines whether force-controlled contact capacitor-discharge stud welding can create local interfaces on spacecraft-relevant aluminium surfaces in vacuum.
engineering_relevance: This approach could support localized attachment to aluminium spacecraft structures if reliable joints can be demonstrated under relevant conditions.
method: Vacuum processing of spacecraft-relevant aluminium surfaces
evidence_signal: The supplied abstract contains only publication metadata, so it provides no experimental conditions, joint-quality measurements, or feasibility results.
watch_item: Vacuum feasibility and joint reliability cannot be confirmed from the supplied information.
paper_title: Feasibility of force-controlled contact capacitor-discharge stud welding in vacuum for local interface creation on spacecraft-relevant aluminium surfaces
